sql:
SELECT
  t.id AS tenant_id,
  t.name AS tenant_name,
  t.industry,
  t.default_currency_code,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.user_id) AS members_count,
  COUNT(o.id) AS member_orders_count_2025,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.currency_code = t.default_currency_code THEN o.grand_total ELSE 0 END) AS member_revenue_local_sum,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN er.rate IS NOT NULL THEN o.grand_total / er.rate ELSE 0 END), 0) AS member_revenue_eur_converted,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN er.rate IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS orders_missing_exchange_rate_count,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT o.currency_code) > 1 THEN true ELSE false END AS has_mixed_currency_orders
FROM tenants t
JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT la.tenant_id, la.user_id
  FROM loyalty_accounts la
  JOIN orders o2 ON o2.user_id = la.user_id AND o2.tenant_id = la.tenant_id
  WHERE o2.placed_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o2.placed_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
) m ON m.tenant_id = t.id
JOIN orders o ON o.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND o.user_id = m.user_id
  AND o.placed_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.placed_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
LEFT JOIN exchange_rates er ON er.base_code = 'EUR' AND er.quote_code = o.currency_code AND er.as_of = CAST(o.placed_at AS DATE)
WHERE t.industry IN ('Books & Stationery','Food & Coffee','Pet Supplies')
GROUP BY t.id, t.name, t.industry, t.default_currency_code
ORDER BY t.name ASC, t.id ASC
note: Added tenant_id (for unambiguous ordering/joins) and one extra diagnostic flag column (has_mixed_currency_orders) beyond the 8 requested, since the request itself suggested flagging mixed-currency tenants "if easier" and it directly supports the diagnostic question; still well under the 12-column limit. member_revenue_local_sum only sums orders whose currency_code matches default_currency_code, as requested, so any non-matching-currency orders are excluded from that column but still counted in member_orders_count_2025 and converted in member_revenue_eur_converted - comparing the two revenue columns plus orders_missing_exchange_rate_count should reveal whether the €0 is a currency mismatch or a missing-rate gap.
